_readme: AI tools shown as EXAMPLES of tools used in practical, AI-enabled work (Implement #ai-tools). Not partnerships or endorsements, and no one is expected to use all of them. Fields: slug · name · category (a few words) · logo (a local single-colour SVG in assets/icons/tools/, drawn in the section's ink colour) · url (the tool's own site; opens in a new tab) · description (one plain sentence on what it's typically used for). Listed in the order shown. Logo sources: docs/IMAGE-SOURCES.md.

tools.name: Claude
tools.description: Writing, analysis and long documents: drafting, summarizing and thinking a problem through.

tools.name: ChatGPT
tools.description: Everyday drafting, questions and brainstorming in a general-purpose chat assistant.

tools.name: Gemini
tools.description: Google's assistant, also available inside Gmail, Docs and Sheets for teams on Google Workspace.

tools.name: NotebookLM
tools.description: Answers grounded in the sources you upload, such as reports, notes and transcripts.

tools.name: Perplexity
tools.description: Web search that answers with citations, so you can check where each claim comes from.

tools.name: Gamma
tools.description: First drafts of presentations, documents and simple web pages from an outline or prompt.

tools.name: Claude Code
tools.description: Anthropic's coding agent: builds and edits software and automations from plain-language instructions.

tools.name: Codex
tools.description: OpenAI's coding agent: writes, reviews and changes code for software and automation tasks.
